title: Golden button+ #Cm
description: The resource pack was created for CounterMine on the Fabric loader.
body:
This resource pack recycles the names of buttons and their appearance, as well as some elements of the _Minecraft_ interface. Supports mods such as **"Sodium"**, **"Mod Menu"** and **"Simple Voice Chat"**.

**Attention!**
The resource pack was created for the _CounterMine_ and it will not be very pleasant to play with it on other projects.
